text.font-family: JetBrains Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace

svg.text: Pivot 3 · Settings of a value field (context menu, or the chip's ▾ menu in the panel)
Right-click inside the pivot, or open the chip's ▾ menu. Every entry has a key: Ctrl+Alt+E, M, Q (proposals).
Summarize by: Sum, Count, Average, Min and Max first. Standard deviation, Variance and Median follow with registered SQL aggregates.
The number format is one of the workbook's named formats. Show values as (%, running total) is for later.
Delete Pivot Table… asks first and is undoable; its cells empty, the source is untouched.
